library.renderer: Game_Music_Emu fast SPC DSP; original SPC700 driver from supplied ROM; dry isolation; not a full-console recording

audioRendering.leadingSilencePolicy: Trim command latency; retain 16 frames before first nonzero sample
audioRendering.trailingSilencePolicy: Retain 320 frames after last nonzero sample
audioRendering.noteGate: Original composer gate ticks, independent of tempo; no amplitude normalization
audioRendering.accuracyLimit: Fast DSP approximates some interpolation and timing; isolated driver state, not full console / analog capture
